text.en:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perlembagaan Persekutuan
(Persempadanan Bahagian-Bahagian Pilihan Raya) (Negeri-Negeri Tanah Melayu)

(2)   Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 29 Mac 2018.

Syor-syor hendaklah berkuat kuasa

2. Syor-syor yang terkandung dalam laporan Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya
bertarikh 6 Mac 2018  hendaklah berkuat kuasa dari tarikh Perintah ini mula
berkuat kuasa.

Dibuat 28 Mac 2018
[PM(R)11880/A088/4 Jld.5; SPR(R)60 Jld.20; PN(PU2)171C/IX]

Dengan Titah Perintah

TAN SRI DR. ALI BIN HAMSA
Setiausaha Jemaah Menteri

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION

FEDERAL CONSTITUTION (DELIMITATION OF CONSTITUENCIES)
(STATES OF MALAYA) ORDER 2018

WHEREAS the Election Commission have , in accordance with the requirements of
Clause (2) of Article 113 of the Federal Constitution, reviewed the division of
the States of Malaya (including Federal Territories of Kuala Lumpur, Labua n and
Putrajaya) into Parliamentary c onstituencies and the division of each State within
the States of Malaya into State constituencies:

AND WHEREAS the Election Commiss ion have , in accordance with section 8 of
Part II of the Thirteenth Schedule to the Fe deral Constitution, submitted to
the Prime Minister on 9 March 2018 their report containing recommendations
with respect to the delimitation of the Parliamentary constituencies in the States of
Malaya (including Federal Territories of Kuala Lumpur, Labuan and Putrajaya)  and
the State constituencies in each State within the States of Malaya:

AND WHEREAS the report of the Election Commission has been laid
before the House of Representatives under section 9 of the Thirteenth Schedule  to
the Federal Constitution:

NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 12 of
the Thirteenth Schedule  to the Fe deral Constitution, the Yang di -Pertuan Agong makes
the following order:

Citation and commencement
